notablePrerequisites: Freed from the Real attached to Kiki-Jiki.
description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Treva's Attendant with haste.
Activate the Treva's Attendant token by paying {1} and sacrificing it, adding {G}{W}{U}.
Activate Freed from the Real's second ability by paying {U}, untapping Kiki-Jiki.
Repeat.
